paragraphs.en: 1 A Summer Where the Sun Never Sleeps I wake up to the sound of the wind buffeting the {cloth} of my tent. Even though the sun is brightly shining, telling whether it is morning or night is impossible. I'm above the Arctic Circle, where in summer the sun never sets. Checking my watch, I see that it is 7:30 a.m. I leave my tent and walk over to the mountain {edge}. Spreading out before me, branches of the Rapa River flow through the {valley} below. I'm in the remote far north of Sweden in Sarek National Park, a place with no roads or towns.
paragraphs.cn: 1 太阳永不沉睡的夏天：风噼里啪啦地拍打着我的帐篷，我在这声音中醒来。即便阳光明媚，也无法分辨是早晨还是夜晚。我在北极圈以北，夏天太阳永不落山。看了看手表，我发现已是早上 7:30。我离开帐篷，走到山边。拉帕河的条条支流在我眼前铺展开来，流经下面的山谷。我身处瑞典最北端偏僻的萨雷克国家公园，一个既没有公路也没有城镇的地方。

paragraphs.en: 2 A Land of Mountain and Ice Sarek's mountains used to be covered by {vast} sheets of ice. Around 9,000 years ago, this ice melted, leaving behind about 100 glaciers. Soon after, {reindeer} began to arrive. Following the {reindeer} were the Sami people, who made this {territory} their home. Getting here is quite difficult, so apart from the Sami very few people have ever seen Sarek. In 1909, Sarek was made a national park in order to keep the land in its natural state. Though the Sami are allowed to continue their traditional way of life in the park, no one else can live here, and all new development is banned within park boundaries. At the far side of the {valley}, an ancient Sami {cottage} is {visible}. Close by, there are a few {reindeer} feeding on grass.
paragraphs.cn: 2 山与冰之地：萨雷克的山脉曾经被巨大的冰层覆盖。大约 9000 年前，这些冰融化了，留下了约 100 条冰川。不久之后，驯鹿来到这里。跟在驯鹿之后到来的是萨米人，他们在这片土地上安了家。抵达这里相当困难，因此除了萨米人，很少有人见过萨雷克。1909 年，萨雷克被列为国家公园，以保持这片土地的自然状态。虽然萨米人被允许在公园里延续他们的传统生活方式，但其他人不可以在这里居住，公园范围内的一切新开发项目都被禁止。在山谷的另一边，一座古老的萨米人小屋清晰可见。近旁，有几只驯鹿在草地上吃草。

paragraphs.en: 3 Man at Peace with Nature For hundreds of years, looking after {reindeer} was a way of life for the Sami. They used the {reindeer}'s meat for food, their bones for tools, and their skin for making clothes and tents. Since {reindeer} were always on the move, the Sami would pick up their tents and {accompany} them. Today, most Sami have houses in villages near Sarek and live a modern life just like their neighbours. But every spring, a small number of Sami still follow their {reindeer} into the valleys of Sarek, living in tents or old cottages and enjoying their traditions. I am not a Sami, but in Sarek I've adopted some of their habits. For example, this morning my breakfast is flat bread warmed over a fire, dried {reindeer} meat, and some sweet and sour berries that I found growing near my tent.
paragraphs.cn: 3 与自然和谐共处的人：数百年来，照料驯鹿一直是萨米人的一种生活方式。他们用驯鹿肉做食物，用鹿骨制作工具，用鹿皮做衣服和帐篷。由于驯鹿总在迁徙，萨米人便会收起帐篷、一路相随。如今，大多数萨米人在萨雷克附近的村庄里有房舍，并像他们的邻居一样过着现代化的生活。但每年春天，仍有少数萨米人跟随他们的驯鹿进入萨雷克的山谷，住在帐篷或旧农舍里，享受他们的传统。我不是萨米人，但在萨雷克，我也养成了他们的一些习惯。比如，今天早上我的早餐是火上烤热的扁面包、驯鹿肉干，还有我在帐篷附近采到的酸甜浆果。

paragraphs.en: 4 A Land of Adventure After breakfast, I pack my bag and set out again. Since I must carry all of my food and supplies with me, my bag weighs about 30 kilograms. If today is anything like yesterday, it will be full of sweat and hard work as I hike over this difficult land to my destination on the other side of the {valley}. However, I cannot complain. Being in such a beautiful and wild place makes me feel blessed to be alive. Here I am, alone under this broad sky, breathing the fresh air, and enjoying this great adventure. What could be better?
paragraphs.cn: 4 冒险之地：早饭后，我收拾好背包再次出发。由于必须随身携带全部食物和补给，我的包约重 30 公斤。如果今天和昨天差不多，那将充满汗水和艰辛，因为我要徒步翻越这片艰难的土地，前往山谷另一端的目的地。然而，我不能抱怨。身处如此美丽而荒凉的地方，让我深感活着是一种幸运。我独自一人，在这广阔的天空下，呼吸着清新的空气，享受着这场伟大的冒险。还有什么能比这更好？

vocab.meaning: 极好的；极大的；难以置信的
